verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a compliance dashboard that shows state status and upcoming deadlines, and says it tracks and files annual reports itself. That is a human-facing UI plus a managed service, not a programmatic API or webhook an agent could consume. The only API mention is a vague "Advanced API integrations" pricing line that is not tied to entity standing or deadlines, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no evidence of the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can watch entity standing and filing deadlines through an API or webhook and raise them before they lapse
